Hi Laura & David,

Thanks again for the time earlier. Attached is a lightweight MAP draft (catalystmed_MAP_v1.xlsx) that captures milestones, acceptance criteria, and our proposed capacity reservation path for your Dedicated/Private deployment. Key asks for your team to confirm so we can lock lead times with procurement: 

- Eval runway: 4 weeks (staging + perf + security).
- Initial GPU pool (tranche A): 8x A100-80GB equivalent for evaluation bursts.
- Production tranche (at-goal): 32x A100-80GB equivalent, split across 2 availability zones for redundancy.
- Lead times: Dedicated pool procurement estimate 10–14 weeks after signed reservation; Private on-prem depending on on-site provisioning ~12–18 weeks.

Our proposal includes two escape hatches so CatalystMed can start production traffic sooner:
1) Short-term hosted burst capacity (managed by Redwood) to cover traffic during procurement lead time.
2) Staggered tranches — commit to a smaller initial production tranche and scale to full pool when hardware arrives.

Please confirm: 1) whether the initial tranche size is acceptable, 2) if procurement window (mid-July target) is feasible for you, and 3) any compliance gating (SOC2 evidence items) that could affect acceptance timing.

I attached the MAP and a placeholder sizing sheet. If helpful, we can slot a 30-minute MAP walkthrough Monday.

Thanks,

Quick sizing notes (high-level) — drafting this into GPU-sizing-estimate-v2.pdf and will attach to the customer MAP doc: 

- Eval tranche (A): 8x A100-80GB eq. -> supports ~150k prompt tokens/minute total; expected 2–3 concurrent large-generation flows for CatalystMed's RLHF sampling.
- Staging buffer (B): +8x A100-80GB eq. as a hot-cache layer. Purpose: prefix caching & KV offload to absorb spikes and reduce tail latency for 95th percentile.
- Production tranche (C): additional 16x A100-80GB eq. -> total 32x across AZs (16/16).

Fallbacks / escape hatches: 
- Hosted burst: if procurement slips >4 weeks, we can enable a managed hosted pool sized to their requested tranche for up to 8 weeks. Estimated delta cost: $X/hr per A100-equivalent + token-based variable; see quick calc below.
- Staggered billing: initial commit ties to tranche A on sign; tranche B/C billed on acceptance milestones.

Lead-time assumptions (engineering + procurement): 
- Dedicated (Redwood-managed on customer VPC): parts ordering + allocation ~10–14 weeks; reservoir for shipping delays + staging adds 2–4 weeks.
- Private (on-prem): rack + kitting + security review ~12–18 weeks; heavy variance depends on site readiness.

I'll attach GPU-sizing-estimate-v2.pdf with the table and a simple QPS mapping.
